# Hanguk v1 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A PWA that trains Korean listening, speaking, reading, writing and vocabulary for a professor, with lessons generated by Claude and grounded in the user's field.

**Architecture:** Single-page Preact app. Pure modules (prompts, SRS, level, diff) are unit tested. One `chat()` wrapper calls Claude with a Zod schema via structured outputs. Speech uses browser TTS/STT. State lives in IndexedDB (`idb`) and `localStorage` (settings).

**Tech Stack:** Vite 7, Preact 10, TypeScript 5, `@anthropic-ai/sdk`, `zod`, `idb`, `vite-plugin-pwa`, Vitest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-26-hanguk-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- Default model `claude-sonnet-5` (user approved), changeable in Settings.
- API key only in `localStorage` key `hanguk.settings`; never in the repo.
- Browser client: `new Anthropic({ apiKey, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true })`.
- Speech: TTS `speechSynthesis` `ko-KR`; STT `webkitSpeechRecognition` `ko-KR`.
- All prompt builders return `{ system, user, schema }` and every Claude reply is parsed with `client.messages.parse` + `zodOutputFormat`.
- Contexts: `teaching | presenting | discussing`. Skills: `listen | speak | read | write`.
- Level per skill: integer 3..6, starts at 3.
- UI labels in Vietnamese. Korean content in Hangul. Glosses in Vietnamese.
- Files under 300 lines. No module imports another module's UI.
- Commit after every task with a conventional-commit message.

### Task 2: Types, settings, SRS, level, diff (pure logic, TDD)

**Files:** `src/types.ts`, `src/store/settings.ts`, `src/store/srs.ts`, `src/store/level.ts`, `src/lib/diff.ts`, `tests/srs.test.ts`, `tests/level.test.ts`, `tests/diff.test.ts`

**Produces:**
```ts
export type Context = "teaching" | "presenting" | "discussing";
export type Skill = "listen" | "speak" | "read" | "write";
export interface Settings { apiKey: string; model: string; ttsRate: number; field: string;
  levels: Record<Skill, number>; history: Record<Skill, number[]>; }
export interface Card { id: string; ko: string; vi: string; example: string; context: Context;
  ease: number; interval: number; reps: number; due: number; }
export interface LessonResult { id: string; skill: Skill; context: Context; score: number; date: number; }
// srs.ts
export function review(card: Card, quality: 0|1|2|3|4|5, now: number): Card
export function newCard(p: Pick<Card,"ko"|"vi"|"example"|"context">, now: number): Card
// level.ts
export function nextLevel(level: number, history: number[]): number   // history = last scores (0..100)
export function pushScore(history: number[], score: number): number[] // keep last 10
// diff.ts
export type Seg = { t: "same"|"add"|"del"; s: string };
export function charDiff(target: string, actual: string): Seg[]
export function similarity(target: string, actual: string): number // 0..1
```

```ts
// tests/srs.test.ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest";
import { newCard, review } from "../src/store/srs";
const base = newCard({ ko: "유동층", vi: "tầng sôi", example: "", context: "teaching" }, 0);
test("new card is due now", () => { expect(base.due).toBe(0); expect(base.reps).toBe(0); });
test("quality 5 first review -> 1 day", () => {
  const c = review(base, 5, 0); expect(c.interval).toBe(1); expect(c.reps).toBe(1);
  expect(c.due).toBe(86400000); });
test("second good review -> 6 days", () => {
  const c = review(review(base, 4, 0), 4, 0); expect(c.interval).toBe(6); });
test("fail resets reps and interval", () => {
  const c = review(review(base, 5, 0), 1, 0); expect(c.reps).toBe(0); expect(c.interval).toBe(1); });
test("ease never below 1.3", () => {
  let c = base; for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) c = review(c, 3, 0); expect(c.ease).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1.3); });
```

```ts
test("pushScore keeps last 10", () => {

test("level up when 10-lesson avg > 85", () => { expect(nextLevel(3, Array(10).fill(90))).toBe(4); });
test("no level up with fewer than 10", () => { expect(nextLevel(3, Array(9).fill(100))).toBe(3); });
```

```ts
// tests/diff.test.ts
import { expect, test } from "vitest";
import { charDiff, similarity } from "../src/lib/diff";
test("identical -> one same segment", () => {
  expect(charDiff("안녕", "안녕")).toEqual([{ t: "same", s: "안녕" }]); });
test("missing char shows del", () => {
  expect(charDiff("안녕하세요", "안녕세요")).toEqual([
    { t: "same", s: "안녕" }, { t: "del", s: "하" }, { t: "same", s: "세요" }]); });
test("similarity ignores spaces and punctuation", () => {
  expect(similarity("안녕하세요.", "안녕 하세요")).toBe(1); });
```

- [ ] Implement `srs.ts` (SM-2): quality<3 → reps=0, interval=1; else reps 1→1 day, 2→6 days, n→round(prev*ease); ease = max(1.3, ease + 0.1 - (5-q)*(0.08+(5-q)*0.02)); due = now + interval*86400000. Initial ease 2.5.
- [ ] Implement `level.ts`: `pushScore` slices last 10; `nextLevel` returns level+1 (max 6) when history.length>=10 and mean>85.
- [ ] Implement `diff.ts`: normalize by removing `\s` and `[.,!?~…]`; LCS DP table over chars; walk back to build segments, merging runs; `similarity = 2*lcs/(len(a)+len(b))`, 0 when either is empty.
- [ ] `settings.ts`: `loadSettings()` returns defaults merged with JSON from `localStorage["hanguk.settings"]`; `saveSettings(s)`. Defaults: model `claude-sonnet-5`, ttsRate 1, field "computational fluid dynamics, multiphase flow, chemical engineering; teaches at a Korean university", levels all 3, history all []. Must not touch `localStorage` when it is undefined (Node tests).

```ts
// prompts/listen.ts
export const ListenLesson = z.object({ title: z.string(), script: z.string(), gloss_vi: z.string(),
  questions: z.array(z.object({ q: z.string(), choices: z.array(z.string()).length(3), answer: z.number().int().min(0).max(2) })).length(3),
  vocab: z.array(z.object({ ko: z.string(), vi: z.string(), example: z.string() })).min(5).max(10) });

// prompts/read.ts  -> ReadLesson (same shape as ListenLesson but text 150-250 words)

export const ShadowSet = z.object({ sentences: z.array(z.object({ ko: z.string(), vi: z.string() })).length(6) });
export const RoleplayTurn = z.object({ reply_ko: z.string(), reply_vi: z.string(), done: z.boolean() });
export const RoleplayFeedback = z.object({ honorific: z.string(), naturalness: z.string(),
  better: z.array(z.object({ you_said: z.string(), better: z.string(), why_vi: z.string() })).length(3), score: z.number().int().min(0).max(100) });
export function shadowPrompt(s, context), roleplayStart(s, context) -> { system, opening_user }, roleplayFeedbackPrompt()
// prompts/write.ts
export const WriteTask = z.object({ task_vi: z.string(), task_ko: z.string(), hints: z.array(z.string()).max(5) });
export const WriteReview = z.object({ corrected: z.string(), edits: z.array(z.object({ from: z.string(), to: z.string(), why_vi: z.string() })), score: z.number().int().min(1).max(5), comment_vi: z.string() });
```

- [ ] `claude.ts`:

```ts
import Anthropic from "@anthropic-ai/sdk";
import { zodOutputFormat } from "@anthropic-ai/sdk/helpers/zod";
export async function chat<T>({ system, messages, schema, settings }) {
  if (!settings.apiKey) throw new ApiKeyMissing("Chưa có API key");
  const client = new Anthropic({ apiKey: settings.apiKey, dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true });
  const run = () => client.messages.parse({ model: settings.model, max_tokens: 4096, system, messages,
    output_config: { format: zodOutputFormat(schema), effort: "medium" } });
  let res = await run();
  if (!res.parsed_output) res = await run();           // one retry
  if (!res.parsed_output) throw new Error("Claude trả về sai định dạng");
  return res.parsed_output;
}
```
  Verify `dangerouslyAllowBrowser` exists: `grep -rn dangerouslyAllowBrowser node_modules/@anthropic-ai/sdk/client.d.ts`.
